name: Kisosaki (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kisosaki town emblem in yellow: a crown-like device above a ring enclosing a stylised leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Kisosaki, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1978.

features.role: Kisosaki town emblem — a crown-like device above a ring enclosing a stylised leaf
